sheets.title: FLOOR PLAN - NEW WORK
sheets.source_file: M-101 FLOOR PLAN - NEW WORK M-101 FLOOR PLAN - NEW WORK (1).pdf (also in combined set page 1)
sheets.reading_notes: Single-story floor plan showing a small commercial building footprint (appears roughly 50' x 70' from graphic scale). New work items tagged 1-4 in plan: (1) Exhaust Hood — CaptiveAire Model 5/30, 10'-1/2" Wide x 5'-0" Deep x 29-1/2" Tall, Type 1 Hood, 208V 3-Phase, 1100 CFM exhaust; (2) Hotplate/Countertop Gas Stove — ATOSA USA Model ATSP-2448-1, 48"W x 30"D x 10.5"H, 4 burners, 64,000 BTU total; (3) Gas Griddle — ATOSA USA Model ACHP-2, 24"W x 28"D, 60,000 BTU total; (4) Gas Double-Deck Convection Oven — Blodgett Model DF-100 DBL, 3-Phase 60Hz 6.0A. Building appears L-shaped or with an annex. Metal joists/decking structure per M-102. No electrical discipline drawings in set; electrical connection requirements for hood noted in construction notes (208V, 3-phase). No plumbing drawings. Construction note references for standalone gas equipment suggest gas rough-in not in this scope. No drawing for gas rough-in visible.

claims.note: Low-resolution combined set M-102 construction note 1 reads '800 CFM' for the Dayton exhaust fan
High-resolution standalone M-102 sheet construction note 1 reads '1800 CFM' for the same Dayton exhaust fan

conflict_flags.rationale: The standalone high-resolution sheet provides clearer, more legible text. Low-res combined set likely rendered the '1' in '1800' below legibility threshold. The make-up air unit is 2000 CFM, which is consistent with an 1800 CFM exhaust fan (slight positive pressure makeup); 800 CFM exhaust with 2000 CFM makeup would be severely unbalanced for a Type 1 hood. 1800 CFM is the more credible value.
